services.desc: Longer, more technical or farther away from town, these rides are half day excursions that offer everything from must do classics on famous trails to little known gems and combinations of some of the best local rides.All of these trails will require anywhere from 5-7 hours including travel to and from, with higher remoteness ratings more expansive views, and the most epic rides. As of Sept. 2021 our guests ride the very best late model year bikes rented from local bike shops. This means all the most modern bells and whistles on the best bikes in the industry. We pick up your bike before the program and drop it off afterwards. Every one of our mountain bike adventures includes a GoPro video,

blurb: Paragon Adventures provides innovative, private, and customized adventures including canyoneering, zip lining, rock climbing, mountain biking, and adventure day hikes. They emphasize safety with a 30+ year record and a high guide to guest ratio. Digital photos of every adventure are included.
